title: Decentralized SLO aggregation and regional circuit orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a decentralized SLO aggregation pipeline and a region-aware circuit orchestration dashboard/playbook that lets on-call and runtime controllers reason about token-level latency SLIs, regional degradation index, and coordinated load-shedding decisions. The goal is to provide deterministic, testable failover behavior when a single region or shard exhibits sustained token-latency inflation or KV-cache miss storms.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Aggregation service emits normalized SLI time-series per (org,route,model_variant,region,shard) every 10s
A2: Dashboard with panels for regional degradation index, token-latency quantiles, admission pressure, and circuit state transitions is deployed in Grafana folder 'regional-resilience'
A3: Pager rule defined: when RegionalDegradationIndex(region) > 0.7 for 5m, alert pages P1 and triggers automated canary fallback to compatible model variant in alternate region
A4: Playbook documented with exact rollback/unroll steps and postmortem checklist linked from runbook
A5: End-to-end canary test demonstrates graceful failover without increased 95th-percentile user-visible latency across regions in synthetic traffic simulation
tasks: T1: Define Regional Degradation Index (RDI) formula and thresholds (owner: Marcus)
T2: Instrument token-level histogram buckets in inference runtime with labels: region, shard, model_variant, route, batch_size, kv_hit
T3: Build aggregation worker that reduces per-shard token histograms into per-region SLI summaries (10s rollup)
T4: Add Prometheus exporters for aggregated SLIs and expose: rdi, token_p50/p95/p99, admit_rate, kv_hit_rate, queue_depth
T5: Design Grafana panels and alerts; create README with alert semantics and escalation path
T6: Implement a simulated failover in the chaos lab and run three blast-radius experiments
T7: Update runtime fallback policy config to accept 'rdi' input and test policy decision path
T8: Write runbook playbook steps and link GitHub PR and test artifacts
metrics_spec: derived: token_p95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, region, model_variant, route))
derived: token_p99 = histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, region, model_variant, route))
metric: inference_admit_total{result="admitted"} and inference_admit_total{result="rejected"} to compute admit_rate per route
metric: kv_cache_hits_total / kv_cache_requests_total -> kv_hit_rate per shard
computed: RegionalDegradationIndex(region) = weighted_normalized(token_p99(region), kv_miss_rate(region), queue_depth_norm(region)) — weights: 0.6 / 0.3 / 0.1 (initial)
dashboard_panels: Panel: Regional Degradation Index (heatmap) - show RDI by region and minute-timeseries
Panel: Token latency quantile waterfall - stacked p50/p95/p99 by model_variant and route
Panel: Admission pressure and backlog - queue depth, in-flight count, and recent reject ratio
Panel: KV cache health - kv_hit_rate, miss burst markers correlated with token-p99 spikes
Panel: Circuit state timeline - shows circuit OPEN/THROTTLE/CLOSED per shard with annotations for automated actions
Panel: Synthetic canary success rate and cross-region user-latency (synthetic user response p95)
promql_examples: token_p99 per model/region: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, region, model_variant))
rdi base components: rdi_token = clamp((token_p99 - 0.03) / 0.12, 0, 1); rdi_kv = 1 - kv_hit_rate; rdi = 0.6*rdi_token + 0.3*rdi_kv + 0.1*queue_norm
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Staging: Enable histogram export and aggregation worker for staging clusters only (2 weeks)
Phase 1: Canary: Deploy Grafana panels and alerts to 'canary' orgs (3 days), run synthetic canaries
Phase 2: Gradual rollout: 10% orgs -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback on alert thresholds
Phase 3: Runtime integration: hook rdi into fallback policy to allow automated cross-region reroute when RDI > 0.8 for 3m
testing_plan: Unit tests for aggregation worker and histogram reduction correctness
Integration tests: end-to-end from runtime metric emission -> Prometheus -> aggregation -> Grafana + alert firing in dev env
Chaos tests: inject KV-miss storms and artificial token-latency spikes in a single region and validate RDI and circuit transitions
Load tests: synthetic traffic with mixed short/long sequences to verify no false positives under normal multi-tenant noise
risks_mitigations: Risk: Over-sensitive thresholds cause unnecessary cross-region failovers. Mitigation: conservative initial weights and 30m cooldown window for automated failover; require human confirmation above critical customers

Risk: Metric cardinality explosion from too many label combinations. Mitigation: Perform label cardinality audit, collapse low-value labels (e.g., batch_size consolidation) and add sampling for low-traffic shards
Risk: Aggregation worker becomes single point of failure. Mitigation: run aggregation in a small fleet per-region with leaderless, idempotent reduction and persistent checkpoints
Risk: Alert fatigue for SREs. Mitigation: route low-severity RDI warnings to dashboards/SLACK only; only escalate P1 when multiple signals align
notes: We intentionally decouple user-visible response SLOs from token-level SLIs; token SLIs drive automated mitigation while user SLOs are used for customer-facing reporting
Experiment idea: replace static RDI weights with a simple logistic regression trained on historical incidents to predict true-positive incident windows
Coordinate with PM for tenant-facing communication templates for automated regional routing events
